# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates

Predicates are type-safe conditions used to filter records in [`select`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/methods/select), [`update`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/methods/update), [`upsert`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/methods/upsert) and [`delete`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/methods/delete). They are built from the `Fields` namespace generated by the [`@SurrealModel` macro](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/models).
##  Comparison operators[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates#comparison-operators)
Each field supports the standard comparison operators:

```swift
Person.Fields.name == "Ada"
Person.Fields.name != "Bob"
Person.Fields.age > 18
Person.Fields.age >= 21
Person.Fields.age < 65
Person.Fields.age <= 60
```

##  Combining predicates[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates#combining-predicates)
Combine predicates with the logical operators `&&`, `||` and `!`:

```swift
let combined = Person.Fields.age >= 18 && Person.Fields.published == true
let either = Person.Fields.age < 18 || Person.Fields.name == "Admin"
let negated = !(Person.Fields.published == false)
```

##  Raw predicates[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates#raw-predicates)
When you need an expression that the DSL does not cover, or when using a [manually conformed model](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/models#manual-conformance) without a `Fields` namespace, you can supply a raw SurrealQL condition:

```swift
let raw = SurrealPredicate(raw: "age > 18 AND name != 'Bot'")
```

##  Using a predicate[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift/concepts/predicates#using-a-predicate)
Pass a predicate to any method that accepts a `where:` argument:

```swift
let adults = try await client.select(
    Person.self,
    where: Person.Fields.age >= 18,
    limit: 20,
    start: 0
)
```
